data.title: Ebastine
data.summary: Antihistamines · Second-generation H1 antihistamine — piperidine (prodrug of carebastine)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antihistamines_

**Class:** Second-generation H1 antihistamine — piperidine (prodrug of carebastine)

## Mechanism of action
- Converted in liver (CYP3A4) to carebastine — selective H1 inverse agonist

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Chronic urticaria, allergic rhinitis

## Dose & formulations
- 10–20 mg once daily

## Adverse effects
- Headache, dry mouth; QT prolongation possible at high doses or with CYP3A4 inhibitors

## Contraindications
- Severe liver impairment; long QT

## Drug interactions
- Ketoconazole/erythromycin raise levels (QT caution)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data — avoid.

## Viva points
- Prodrug activated by CYP3A4; QT caution with azoles/macrolides

_Sources: Khopkar (Second generation H1 antihistamines). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
